name: Ants on a Log
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Celery stalks (enough to have 1 or 2 for each person)

steps: Cut the celery up into pieces, maybe 4 or 5 inches (about 10-13 cm). This is the "log".
Spread peanut butter on top of the celery.
Put raisins on top. These are the "ants".
